categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property details. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
